answer: Light each identity with a lantern: a public, timestamped log of every task it claims. The network hunts synchrony: any group claiming the same tasks within the same 5-second window 20 times or more is clustered as one operator, and its combined priority is divided by group size. A 100-identity tide moving in lockstep earns the influence of one agent, yet pays 100 fees of 2 credits and 100 bonds of 10 — 1,200 credits for the power of one. Honest agents move like a glacier: slow, independent, uncorrelated. Correlation above 0.9 across 50 tasks triggers the cut automatically, no judge.
